title: 알비온 코치 — 화면 세계 고르기
question: 추첨으로 '한국 증권 시세판' 방향이 배정됐습니다. 그대로 갈지, 다른 카드를 고를지, 다시 뽑을지 골라 주세요.

options.label: 시세판 (Korean quote board)
options.lineage: Korean brokerage quote screens: red ▲ up, blue ▼ down, tabular price rows
options.thesis: Refining profit read like a Korean stock quote: cities ranked as a 호가 ladder, gain red, loss blue.
options.viewport: Top bar with tabs (코치 / 정제 계산기) and Asia badge; left: filters + city ladder with profit bars around a centre axis; right: coach chat.
options.risk: Can read as a generic dark finance app if the ladder is drawn timidly.

raised.raise: Every rule, bar edge and axis at one device pixel; palette held to graphite, numeral white and the two market colours, amber only for refresh.
Columns never move: fixed-width tabular cells, so a price refresh changes digits, never layout.
No card chrome: the profit figure at display scale carries the hierarchy, not boxes.
Nothing labelled twice: each city named once per row, its refining bonus as a single tincture chip.
Fixed furniture per city row (bonus chip, data age) in the same slot on every refresh.

options.label: Royal city tinctures
options.lineage: heraldic tinctures of Albion's royal cities (Martlock azure, Lymhurst vert, Bridgewatch or, Thetford purpure, Caerleon gules, Fort Sterling argent)
options.thesis: Every city is its banner colour; the table is a row of tabards and the best city wears its colour at full field.
options.viewport: Same shell; the leading city row floods with its tincture, others carry a tincture edge.
options.risk: Closest to familiar fantasy-game UI; seven hues compete if not disciplined.

options.label: Gate board
options.lineage: airport departure boards and boarding passes
options.thesis: Cities rerank in place like flights; a changed price stays lit until you have seen it.
options.viewport: Light board of city rows ranked by profit, the chosen recipe as a segmented pass on top.
options.case: Fuses cleanly (ranking is the job) and holds product clarity; loses audience identification to the Korean market convention.
options.risk: Light ground glares beside a dark game at night.

options.label: Centre-rail reference setting
options.thesis: Two text columns around a vermilion rail of keys.
options.viewport: Two columns, apparatus in a wide margin.
options.case: A gamer beside a game does not identify with a critical edition; the margin wastes phone width.
options.risk: Reads as a book, not a tool.
options.kept: One-device-pixel ruling and a three-value palette discipline.

options.label: Character goods catalog
options.thesis: Cities as ranked mascots with fixed name plates.
options.case: Pastel cuteness fights Albion's full-loot grit; cells hide the numbers.
options.kept: Fixed personal furniture per entry in a fixed slot.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.thesis: Giant cropped type and live tiles.
options.case: Cropped giant type breaks Korean labels and hides the table.
options.risk: Panorama navigation is unfamiliar for a two-view tool.
options.kept: Chrome deleted: type scale carries hierarchy.

options.label: Catalog sleeve
options.thesis: Colour codes stand in for words.
options.case: Coded labels slow a glance-and-decide task.

options.label: Split-flap concourse
options.case: An instrument costume on a working screen; the cascade adds noise to price refreshes.
options.kept: Columns never move, only values change.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark gaming-tool dashboard community Albion sites ship, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar nav, filter bar, sortable table, chat drawer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every Albion fan tool by design.
